title: Role template
description: One role a venture can install, at packages/naive/template/governance/roles/<id>.json. The founder is the chief delegator and holds all authority; every other role holds only what is granted to it in governance/delegation.json, and only from the classes it lists as grantable. Its work is verified by another role (verified_by), never by itself; only the chief delegator has no verifier. Checked by packages/naive/src/checks/check-delegation.mjs.

aliases.description: Other names for this role (such as cto for architect); the id is canonical and matches agent-roles.json and decision-rights.json

chief_delegator.description: True for the founder only: the root of every delegation chain

function.description: The function the role serves: an id in packages/naive/src/functions/departments.json (such as products, marketing-and-sales or human-capital), or all for the chief delegator and for a lead (a role with a portfolio). packages/naive/src/checks/check-delegation.mjs fails on any other value

portfolio.description: A lead only (lead agents design, 2026-11-08): the functions, ids in packages/naive/src/functions/departments.json, whose cross-function work this lead plans and verifies. A role with a portfolio is a lead: its function is all, it may be granted no never-redelegated class and no one-way door, and the leads' portfolios cover every function exactly once (packages/naive/src/checks/check-delegation.mjs)

default_measure_kinds.description: A lead only: the telos measure kinds it is bound to by default (primary means the telos's primary measure). A venture binds the lead to concrete measure ids in its lead plan (operations/lead/[id]); the defaults only route a task whose measure no lead plan binds (packages/naive/src/engine/route-task.ts)

grantable_classes.description: Decision classes (from decision-rights.json) this role may be granted; the chief delegator lists none, since it holds all

lint_suites.description: Lint routes it runs, such as marketing/brand-lint

verified_by.description: The role that verifies its work; null only for the chief delegator

also_verified_by.description: Further verifiers for some work, such as the founder for spend

skill.description: Path from the repository root to the role's skill
